Hi Elodie —

Thanks for choosing Redwood for the upcoming integration. To finish creating your vendor master record in our finance system we need a couple of quick confirmations so AP/Procurement can route POs and invoices to the right place. Can you confirm the following items by EOD Tuesday?

1) Legal entity name (as registered) and any DBA names.
2) Entity type and tax residence (US / non-US) and TIN/EIN if US.
3) Remittance address for invoices (street + city + postal code).
4) Preferred PO contact (name, email, phone) and AP email for invoice submission.
5) Bank remit instructions (if you accept ACH) or note that you prefer paper checks.
6) Authorized signer name(s) and title(s) for contract/PO acceptance.

Attached is our one-page vendor master form (VendorMaster_Form.xlsx) and a short checklist. If you already have a W‑9 or equivalent, please attach it — that will speed us along.

After we receive this, Procurement will create the vendor record and Kimberly (AP) will confirm PO routing and payment terms. If you prefer a quick call to walk through, I can set aside 20 minutes tomorrow morning.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you set up.

Jonas Weber
